subject: Roadlink MAP starter doc + draft schedule
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@roadlink.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Roadlink MAP starter doc + draft schedule

Hi Asha — great to talk earlier. As promised, I’m sharing a starter Mutual Action Plan (MAP) doc and a lightweight slide stub to capture scope, owners, and a proposed 30-day pilot cadence. I’ve kept the initial template minimal so your team can edit directly. Key asks in this email: confirm technical owners, procurement window, and any red lines on data handling.

Links + attachments:
- MAP (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xRoadlinkMAPTemplate — Roadlink_MAP_TEMPLATE_v0.2.gdoc
- Starter deck (slides): starter-slides-roadlink.pptx
- I’ll follow up with a pricing estimate once we lock scope.

Proposed timeline (high level):
1) Week 0: kickoff + environment access (you provide firewall rules & test accounts)
2) Week 1–3: pilot run (sample dataset, 10k tokens/day)
3) Week 4: review, acceptance criteria check, decision (pilot -> PO/procurement)

Would you aim for a kickoff the week of Nov 8? If procurement needs a later window, we can shift to Nov 15. Please loop in Procurement if you want them on the thread.

Thanks — I’ll get a pricing stub to Marissa the same day for review.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Manager, Sales
Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

Attachments: ROADLINK_MAP_TEMPLATE_v0.2.gdoc, starter-slides-roadlink.pptx

Stephanie — quick internal note while I review the MAP: I made inline comments on the GDoc (access granted to Asha) and attached a first-pass pricing estimate (pricing-estimate-roadlink.xlsx). High-level edits: tighten acceptance criteria in Week 4 (add exact perf targets + eval prompts), and call out who owns data retention policy.

Suggested owners to add to MAP draft:
- Technical lead (Redwood): Jonas Weber
- Customer engineering lead: TBD (Asha — please add)
- Legal/procurement contact: Devon Li (procurement)

Risk flags to confirm before kickoff: SOC2 evidence (customers ask), network allowlist, sample data anonymization. I attached the estimate for your review — numbers are rough until we lock token profile.

— Marissa

Subject: RE: Roadlink MAP starter doc + draft schedule (internal)

Looping in technical notes for the MAP draft — feel free to paste these into the ‘Technical readiness’ section:
- Access: we need a dev/test VM and one service account; SSH + temporary API keys are fine for pilot.
- Network: IP allowlist needed (we’ll provide IP ranges).
- Data: specify sample size (10k tokens/day) and whether PII will be redacted — if not, we’ll recommend a pseudonymization step.
- Success metrics: throughput > 200 req/min for QPS pattern, median latency < 500ms (99th < 1s) on the pilot slices.

I’ll add a one-slide ‘Technical owners & gating’ to the starter deck. If Asha confirms owners, I’ll update the GDoc.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer
jonas@redwood.com

Cc: Devon Li <devon.li@roadlink.com>, procurement@roadlink.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadlink MAP starter doc + draft schedule

Thanks, Stephanie — the MAP looks good and the proposed cadence fits our internal goals. A few notes from Procurement/Eng: 

- We can target kickoff the week of Nov 15 (Procurement has a sprint that week).
- Procurement contact: Devon Li (cc’d). They asked for SOC2 summary, basic SLA language, and a draft order form. Can you share SOC2-Redwood-2026-summary.pdf and a sample SLA?
- Technical owner: I’ll assign our integration lead (name to follow) — for now, they’ll attend the kickoff.
- Minor scope ask: include a PII redaction step in Week 1 to remove direct identifiers from the sample dataset.

We reviewed the starter slides and left a couple of comments in the GDoc. Please send the SOC2 summary and the procurement worksheet — I attached our procurement timeline matrix (procurement-timeline-roadlink.xlsx) for visibility.

Best,
Asha Patel
Head of Product
Roadlink
